Veg Spicy Ramen 🍜

Lot of finely chopped veggies were added along with Paneer cubes. Presentation was top notch and it tasted also super delicious.

Manchurian Rice Combo 🍛
Simple combination of Veg Fried Rice along with Manchurian gravy. It tasted so good. Also special mention to the quantity served, more than enough for two people.

Teriyaki Cottage Cheese 🤌🏻 (Must try)
Paneer chunks were prepared well in Teriyaki sauce. It was so flavourful and wholesome. Absolutely loved this one.

Prices are super affordable. Also they make orders in max 15-20 mins once placed. The Kitchen is well maintained and hygienic. Also it’s open till 2am midnight and closed on Monday.
So if you are planning to order Korean or Chinese next time, do give this a try!!

featured_reviews.name: Naresh Shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
In a neighbourhood where Indo-Chinese kitchens often fluctuate between overly greasy and underwhelming, Stir Fry Grill has managed to maintain a steady standard for years. We’ve been ordering from and dining here for a long time now, and what keeps us returning isn’t hype — it’s consistency. The flavours remain reliable, the portions generous, and the pricing reasonable, which is increasingly rare in the Malad area.

What truly stands out is how well they balance quantity with quality. The food doesn’t try to be experimental or overly refined; instead, it focuses on delivering bold, satisfying Oriental flavours that work every single time.

Our regular staples include the Chicken Triple Rice, hearty and filling with properly spiced gravy; the Nasi Goreng, aromatic and flavour-packed; the Malaysian Flat Noodles, carrying that pleasant smoky wok finish; and the always dependable Crispy Chicken, which lives up to its name with a satisfying crunch.

Their starters have consistently impressed over the years. The Chicken Lollipop (dry) and Chicken 65 are flavourful and well-portioned. The Chilli Chicken (Dry) and Dragon Chicken deliver that classic spicy-tangy Indo-Chinese kick. Even vegetarian favourites like Veg Crispy, Paneer Chilli (Dry), and Veg Manchurian (Dry) are executed thoughtfully. Seafood options such as Prawns Chilli and Prawns Pepper Garlic add a richer dimension to the menu.

For rice and noodles, reliability continues with Schezwan Fried Rice, Burnt Garlic Fried Rice, and Combination Fried Rice — well seasoned without excessive oil. The Hong Kong Noodles and Schezwan Hakka Noodles are dependable comfort choices. Gravies like Chicken Manchurian, Hot Garlic Chicken, and Schezwan Chicken pair perfectly with these bases. Slightly different offerings such as Thai Green Curry (Chicken) and Veg Thai Curry with Rice are pleasantly balanced and not overly heavy. And when in the mood for nostalgia, the American Chopsuey delivers that familiar sweet-spicy crunch.

Over the years, what has mattered most is not a single standout dish but the steady benchmark they maintain. In an area where Oriental cuisine quality can be inconsistent, Stir Fry Grill continues to offer dependable flavours, satisfying portions, and honest pricing. It comfortably earns an above-average rating — not for flash, but for reliability, which is often far more valuable.

featured_reviews.name: vishal sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Restaurant Review for Flavours of China

Flavours of China offers a delightful dining experience that lives up to its name. The restaurant's vibrant ambiance and comfortable seating make it a perfect spot if you want to experience desi chinese.

The dishes served were flavorful and well-presented. The Foc Lollypop Masala Dry was a standout, offering a perfect balance of spice and texture. It was served in green chatney which was unique to this restaurant. The Chicken Oriental Noodles were another highlight, with a rich, aromatic flavor containing flat noodles and exotic Veges with a kick of spiciness to it. The mocktails , including the Black Tart and Oceanic Orange, were refreshing and rounded off the meal beautifully.

The service was prompt and courteous, and the staff ensured a smooth dining experience. The pricing, considering the portion sizes and quality, was reasonable and value for money.

Overall, Flavours of China is a must-visit for Desi Chinese cuisine lovers seeking a comfortable dining experience. Recommended for its food and service.

featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Khalid Sarfaraz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Flavours of China is located on the main Malad Link Road and is is beside the famous Greens Veg restaurant hence easy to locate. Apart from this they have other outlets at Lalbaug, Parel, Dadar, Prabhadevi, Matunga, Bandra & Borivali.

The restaurant is decent in size with ground plus basement seating available. They have perfectly utilised every part of the property as the seatings are nicely arranged. The ambiance again looks great and have a nice feel of a small China theme as the walls have words written and Chinese lantern on the ceiling looks beautiful.

They specialise in Chinese and Thai food. The options available are great for both vegetarians and non vegetarians. Alao they have acquired Icecreaft ice creams hence you get great options in desserts as well. Prices are not too high and th quantity served is huge. Apart from this they also serve combos which indeed is super pocket friendly.

I went here for a weekday dinner and the place got packed around 9PM. The kitchen service was smooth and dishes came on time. The table service by Staff Rahan was perfect as he was attentive. Special mention to Manager Ganesh as honestly he was among the few managers that I came accross who were very professional and polite plus fully committed to their job. He knew the menu well and he suggested grest options for us. And he single handedly was taking care of all the tables.

What We Had -
APPETIZERS~
Malaysian Chicken -
Sliced chicken done in peanut based creamy sauce tasted delicious. Loved the juiciness of the chicken and the peanut sauce had a hint of chilli in it hence you don't feel too much of peanuts in this.

Chicken Lollypop Schezwan Dry -
Huge lollypops done in schezwan sauce tasted outstanding. The size of the lollypops and the meat on it was marvellous. The sauce again had load of garlic in it still not to overpowering. A must try for lollypop lovers.

MAINS~
Chicken Oriental Noodles -
Flat noodles with exotic veggies, chicken and egg tasted good. Didn't had too much of spices  but taste wise it wasn't bland and had nice taste due to the multiple ingredients in it.

Chicken Five Spice Fried Rice -
Aromatic five spice done in fried rice with chicken and veggies tasted great. Loved the taste of the five spice as it doesn't taste like the normal fried rice.

DESSERTS~
Loconuts Ice Cream Roll -
Chocolate ice cream, almonds, brownie and chocolate sauce tasted heavenly. A great end to a perfect meal.

MOCKTAILS~
Oceanic Orange.
Grey Mango.
Both the drinks were nicely made with perfect ratio of syrup and soda hence perfect.

So the meal at Flavours of China was excellent from start to end as the food taste excellent, the service is great and the ambiance is nice. Hence this place should not be missed.

featured_reviews.name: SGT Reviews
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ First Impressions & Location

Asia Kitchen sits on the first floor of Infiniti Mall 2, Malad, tucked beside the main food court walkway. Easy to spot, hard to ignore
that neon signage practically screams “Asian feast incoming”.
Ambience? Clean, modern, and very “pan-Asian chic”.

But let’s get to our experience… because the evening was a bit of a rollercoaster.

🍽️ What We Ordered

We went with a mix of classics and comfort bowls:
1. Papaya Salad (Som Tam)
2. Paneer & Chilli Peanut Starter
3. Ramen Bowl
4. Khow Suey
…and here’s where the plot twist enters.

⏱️ Service & Sequencing – The First Red Flag
Before our forks even warmed up, the main course arrived before the appetizer.
Yes… the Ramen Bowl lands first. Then the salad. Then the starter.
It felt like the kitchen was running its own maze without a map.

A small but important detail sequence matters, especially when flavours build on each other.

🍜 The Food — Ranked Best to Worst

1️⃣ Khow Suey – The Undisputed Winner

Creamy, fragrant, balanced, and comforting.
This bowl carried the whole dinner on its back like a Sherpa on Everest.
Perfectly cooked noodles, well-rounded curry broth, and toppings that actually made sense.

2️⃣ Papaya Salad – Crunchy, Fresh & Punchy
Bright flavours, generous peanuts, nice tang.
It’s the palate cleanser you want in an Asian meal, not the afterthought you sometimes get.

3️⃣ Paneer & Chilli Peanut Starter – Decent, Not a Showstopper
Paneer was soft, the peanuts added texture, and the chillies brought heat
but overall, this sat comfortably in the “good, not great” category.

4️⃣ Ramen Bowl – The Problem Child
This one hurt.
The broth? Tasteless.
Temperature? Lukewarm.
We actually had to ask them to reheat it  and even then, it didn’t redeem itself.
For a place that charges premium pricing, a flat ramen bowl is like missing a free throw in front of an open basket.

👨‍🍳 Staff & Experience

Service was polite but the timing issue made the whole meal feel disjointed.
They were courteous when we asked for reheating, but the kitchen clearly needs better coordination.

💸 Value for Money

The ambience and plating say “premium”.
But the portion-to-price ratio + service glitch makes it feel slightly overpriced unless you already love Mainland China’s flavour profile.

🎯 Final Verdict – SGT Scorecard

Ambience: ⭐⭐⭐⭐

Food (Overall): ⭐⭐⭐

Service: ⭐⭐½

Value: ⭐⭐½

Must-Order: Khow Suey

Skip: Ramen Bowl

Final Take:
A good spot for a mall lunch/dinner if you stick to their strengths.
But the service sequencing and the underwhelming ramen definitely took away some of the charm.
Go for the Khow Suey… the rest is optional.

featured_reviews.name: Anirbaan Saha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wok Express Review

Wok Express is exactly what it promises. Tasty , Lip smacking, mind boggling pan asian food on the go. Do not consider this as a fine dining experience because its not but what they have into this food joints is really Incredible.

Atmosphere/Decor:
Nice seating arrangement for nearly about 30-35 peple at a time.. lighting and music gives a very nice and warm feel. You can surely enjoy a good conversation here with your friend or a casual date (wink wink 😉)

The Menu/ Dishes :
The menu offers a wide variety of  delectable items from soups to Dumplings 🥟 to starters to noodles 🍝 etc. Here are the few item we tried and we loved it.

Chinese bhel:
Very crispy mixed with veggies.. We wanted to try just to check how different this is from the street one and it turned out quite healthier than the Chinese bhel available on the street. It’s not Very much spicy and mixed with some veggies.. Priced ₹80

Chicken Manchow Soup :
This was the best thing we tried here. Very nice.. nice texture.. filled with chicken chuncks.. noodle pieces.. some veggies.. gives a very healthy feel.It had a wonderful zing which tasted like awesomeness .. highly recommend priced ₹130.

Aromatic Chicken dumpling with schezwan sauce :
It was lip smacking and has a tangy and spicy tastes.. served at a perfect temperature and its not too spicy though. The key to a perfect dumpling 🥟 is how perfect the outside layer is its not supposed to be too thick or thin... and this was exactly like that. Priced ₹ 190

Chicken  wings in hot crispy garlic sauce:
Perfectly cooked and the sauce makes it better . The wings were perfectly crispy which was soaked into hot crispy garlic sauce. The sauce was perfectly made that blended well with the wings.

Noodle wok box
Famous wok experience.. where you choose everything from veggies and seasoning from the given choice and they serve it exactly the way you want it. We had multigrain noodle with onion, spring onion, Zuchini and Baby corn 🌽. It was tossed in hot crispy garlic sauce with burnt garlic and fresh coriander seasoning. They way served it exactly how we imagined and the temperature was perfect.

Drinks:
We ordered Green apple And minty Mojito which was not great but okay.There was too much ice in it which diluted the taste.

To sum up... we had a wonderful experience herewith food of the most exquisite asian food flavour. For this reason we highly recommend this place. Please find more photograph on our Instagram page @kararichai . Happy hogging 😋😋

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Soneji
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chinese food is my saviour during those times when there is no food at my home or I'm too lazy to make anything.

Wok Express is recently opened up in my area and during those hungry times, it makes it easy for me to visit here as it's closeby.

The outlet has 6 to 8 tables which is basically a good decent area. They have good music playing here, staff is friendly and smiling. Very positive vibes here.

To start with, I ordered the Mango Basil Fizzy drink with the Tapioca pearls. Its my favorite here. I just love how the pearls feel when I drink it.

Schezwan Chicken Bao :

The baos were steamed well. Schezwan chicken could have been a tad bit more spicy for my taste. But overall it was good. Recommended for people who like Baos.

Crunchy Chicken Momos with Sweet,  Tangy and Cheesy Sauce :

Momos are my favorite in Asian cuisine, any day. Here, they serve 5 pcs of momos. This had chicken stuffing on the inside, garnished with creamy cheese sauce on top and fried noodles too. They are placed on a bed of spicy Schezwan sauce. Absolutely loved them.

Chicken Wings in Hot Garlic Sauce :

I had heard from many of my friends to try the chicken wings here. So I chose the wings with hot garlic sauce. The 3pc wings were more than enough for me. The wings were fried and then tossed in hot garlic sauce. They were really crispy on the outside and the sauce was absolute heaven.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

Thai Curry Wok :

I mademy own Wok wherein I chose Steamed Rice, Green Thai Curry, French Beans, Babycorn and Zucchini. For seasoning I chose green chillies, chilli flakes and burnt garlic. Earlier they use to give the curry and the rice separately but now they toss it up together and serve as a wok. I chose the small/personal size for me and it's enough for 1 person if you are a little hungry.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

Burnt Garlic Fried Rice :

I had this coz lately I'm loving  the Burnt Garlic taste. This also had chopped veggies in it and garnished with burnt garlic on top. Its g9od to eat on its own and also good if you wana pair it with some gravy of your choice. I had it on its own.

The food is absolutely delicious and comes hot on the table. The service is pretty quick. This is going to be my go-to place for my Asian hunger pangs.

featured_reviews.name: Ishani Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wok express has always been a saviour to my Chinese cravings.
With its new outlet open in malad, we went on a Sunday noon to try their dine in.

We binged on
Crispy tanuki dumplings: Gave this a shot after trying the assorted vegetable dumplings for a lot number of times. It takes really good, have it with the Spicy chutney provided along.

Crackling spinach sushi: Sushi rolled over a bed of spinach and topped with Fried spinach. Really liked the combination.

Personal wok: We had ramen noodles with  Bangkok sauce and veggies. Couldnt stop myself from slurpping those long noodles.

Ramen noodle soup: Something like a khow suey soup but I liked this one more with ramen noodles and topped with fried onions. The spoon provided along was too flat. Need to work on that.

Drinks: With all these spicy food, we had some refreshing drinks.
Minty mojito
Peach iced tea
strawberry iced tea
Green apple mojito

Dessert : Ending on a sweet note we had
Almond  brittle, it's a dark chocolate coated with nuts!

Cheers to Mr. Raj Shah for his service.

featured_reviews.name: Pritish Nayak
featured_reviews.review_text:
wok
Wok express is quite famous for their Chinese food and proves to be many people's regular place for delicious asian food. We decided to order from it's outlet that is in evershine nagar, malad near infinity mall. The food was delivered on time. All the items were perfectly warm.

What we ordered:
Chilli paneer bao- paneer chilli stuffed between bao which is a white bread. The bread was soft and a bit sweet. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

Peri peri chicken wings-  6-7 wings served with peri peri sauce. They were spicy and tasty. you'll can try if you want something on the spicier side.

Paneer chilli- My personal favourite asian starter of all time. Paneer chilli never let's you down, it was delicious and the paneer tasted very soft and fresh. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

We also tried their desi chilli with ramen noodles box and schezwan with steamed rice box, both of them were in the chef's recommended set wok box and tasted heavenly.

In the desserts, they offer almond brittle which is chocolate topped with crushed almond from all the sides. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
